queries.sql: SELECT `p`.*, `c`.`name` AS `category_name`, `c`.`slug` AS `category_slug`, (SELECT file_name FROM property_images WHERE property_id = p.id ORDER BY is_cover DESC LIMIT 1) AS cover_image FROM `properties` `p` LEFT JOIN `categories` `c` ON `c`.`id` = `p`.`category_id` WHERE `p`.`status` = 'published' AND `p`.`category_id` = '6' AND `p`.`id` != '2' ORDER BY `p`.`published_at` DESC LIMIT 4
